europe_recognition: EHEA level 7 (Bologna) — academic recognition across the EHEA. tuition_eu_eur: EUR 1,162 (2026-27 rates) — 60 ECTS x 19.37 EUR/credit (màster no habilitant, EU/resident) = 1,162.20; UPC fitxa prints €1,162
tuition_non_eu_eur: EUR 2,700 (2026-27 rates) — 60 ECTS x 45.00 EUR/credit (no resident, no UE) = 2,700.00; UPC fitxa prints '€1,162 (€2,700 for non-EU residents)', which matches the arithmetic exactly
fees_extra_eur: EUR 218.15 compulsory study of equivalence of a non-EU foreign degree for access to a máster universitario (Decret 96/2026 §7.4.1, 'Estudi d'equivalència de títol d'estudis estrangers de fora de la Unió Europea per a l'accés als estudis de màster universitari: 218,15 euros') — unavoidable for this Tunisian degree; + academic-record management 54.54 €/semester or 69.80 €/year; + learning-support resources 35.00 €/semester or 70.00 €/year; + 218.15 € issuing of the official degree certificate WITH the European Diploma Supplement (Decret 96/2026 §4.1); + a non-refundable 300 € advance payment on accepting the admission offer. The programme fitxa's headline figure explicitly 'does not include non-teaching academic fees and issuing of the degree certificate'. UPC's own all-in estimate table (which does include the main taxes) gives 3,200 € (60 ECTS) / 4,600 € (90) / 6,100 € (120) for a non-EU non-resident.
modality: presencial (face-to-face); mornings and afternoons — spring entrants take semester 1 in the mornings
language_of_instruction: English (UPC fitxa field 'Language of instruction: English')
start_month: February (and September) — 'Starting September and February'; 'New intake places 20 in September and 10 in February'
notes: CAMPUS: taught at EETAC in CASTELLDEFELS, not Barcelona — the fitxa's 'Location' field reads 'Castelldefels School of Telecommunications and Aerospace Engineering'. FEES: UPC 'Preus i beques' 2026-27 per-credit table, row 'Màster universitari habilitant i no habilitant (no residents, no UE)' = 45 € for 1a matrícula. This 45.00 €/credit is the WHOLE differentiated price, not a surcharge added to the EU rate: it sits in the same column as, and replaces, 'Màster universitari habilitant 17,69 €' / 'Màster universitari no habilitant 19,37 €'. Catalonia's Decret 96/2026 art. 1.5 does not fix the non-EU figure — it authorises each consell social to set it up to 100% of cost — and states that a long-stay study authorisation 'no equival a la condició de residents', so a Tunisian student-visa holder is legally non-resident and pays the 45,00 € column. CONFLICT (unresolved, logged not silently fixed): UPC's own master's FAQ (CA and EN) still prints 'Per-credit fees for non-resident foreign students who are non-European Union students (non-EU residents) are €102.52 for the NON-qualifying master's degree' — irreconcilable with UPC's own price table AND with the per-programme totals UPC itself publishes (102.52 x 60 would be 6,151, not 2,700). Treated as stale; the price table and the programme fitxes agree with each other at 45,00 €. ARITHMETIC: 60 x 45.00 = 2,700 (non-EU) vs 60 x 19.37 = 1,162.20 (EU/resident) — a 2.32x differential. ENTRY (300-ECTS profile): specific requirement is a telecom/ICT engineering degree obtained IN THE EHEA; a Tunisian degree is outside the EHEA, so the fitxa routes it through 'With complementary coursework, another engineering degree from the EHEA or a telecommunications/ICT engineering degree from outside the EHEA. A validation committee will review these applications and may propose complementary coursework.' RUCT records Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos = 0 for the title itself, so any complementos would be imposed at applicant level, not built into the degree. English B2 certificate required. RECOGNITION: the fitxa itself states 'As this is an official master's degree of the European Higher Education Area (EHEA), graduates who hold an official bachelor's degree of at least 240 ECTS and this master's degree of 60 ECTS fulfil the requirement of having at least 300 ECTS in official programmes and may therefore seek admission to a doctoral programme' — this candidate's 300-ECTS bachelor's clears that bar with room to spare.
